plan.notes: Transcribed from the official ARC 'Engineering Technology A.S. Degree (Full Time, Fall Start)' program roadmap, Catalog 2026-27, published July 09, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/7486/PublishedPdf), GE Pattern: local AA/AS, Start Term: Fall. Total Units 60 = 16+15+14+15 (semester sums verified). tccns mirrors ARC local course codes (California community colleges do not use TCCNS). Elective courses: any elective courses numbered 100-499, or having a 4-digit number starting with C. Students can substitute ESLW 340 for ENGL C1000/C1000H. Scheduling: DESGN 310 and 351 are offered in the fall; DESGN 328, 331, 360, and 361 are offered in the spring; DESGN 331 is offered during the 1st 8 weeks and DESGN 361 during the 2nd 8 weeks so they can be taken in the same semester. This degree can be started in the spring as well. DESGN 301 skills are often learned in high school drafting; contact the Design Technology department chair about credit by exam or challenging the prerequisite. A DESGN 498 internship (0.5-4.0 units) is highly recommended and works toward satisfying GE Area L7B. This program is designed for direct workforce entry; students wishing to transfer to a bachelor's degree should meet with a counselor to select appropriate courses and keep a portfolio of design/engineering technology projects.
